actual_request.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE complete original production sprite of 10_crimson_spear_girl, a grounded short-step walking pose, native square at least 1024x1024, genuinely transparent RGBA. No sheet, text, ground, shadow, checkerboard or background. Image 1 is authoritative identity: exact brown double buns AND two long twin tails with red ribbons, gold/turquoise ornaments, amber eyes, jeweled forehead charm, original red/ivory/gold embroidered layered dress, white sleeves and skirt frills, gold waist beads, red/gold boots. Image 2 is the confirmed main STYLE reference, clean bright rounded Daoist chibi hand-painted detail, restrained warm shading, delicate polished edges; do not copy its UI or other people. Image 3 fixes production body/head size, short chibi proportions, outfit, spear and stable two-hand grip. Preserve identity and these proportions; natural three-dimensional turning, never a mirror. Same long dark-shaft crimson crystal and gold spear with red tassels; anatomical LEFT hand high at chest, RIGHT hand low at waist, both physically on ONE straight shaft. Entire spear including butt, head, twin tails, ribbons, sleeves and both boots inside canvas, with margin. Fixed slightly elevated game camera. At 1024 scale: body center x512, virtual ground root [512,942], body/buns-to-boots about700px; full weapon bounds x65..960,y45..952. Maintain compact, balanced small stride, no running/jump/attack/high knee/crossed legs. Anatomical left/right always means HER left/right. Every frame has at least one grounded supporting foot. Torso almost vertical; subtle hair/sleeve inertia only. Highest available finish, no colored matte or purple fringe. DIRECTION NORTHWEST: LEFT-REAR three-quarter view, body faces away toward upper-left, mostly back of head/back of costume and only a slight left cheek; never a front-left portrait. HER anatomical LEFT leg/arm are the NEAR left-side limbs; RIGHT leg is far. Forward step projects upper-left; near LEFT hand remains HIGH at chest and far RIGHT hand LOW at waist with natural back-view occlusion. Keep visible physical grip on one spear. FRAME NW09 of a16-frame walk at30ms: Initial RIGHT heel/sole contact ahead; RIGHT leg leads, LEFT leg behind with toe still touching ground and heel raised. Short double support. Far RIGHT boot must be distinctly further screen-left than near LEFT boot for W, opposite leading leg from01. Image4 is provisional NW01-v3 direction and equipment framing reference ONLY. Keep back-left view, same scale/head size, entire spear and ribbons comfortably inside canvas with transparent margins. Redraw the phase rather than copying legs. The back of head and back costume dominate, only sliver of left cheek. Near LEFT arm high at chest with far RIGHT hand low naturally occluded.SWAP legs from image4: FAR RIGHT leg reaches FORWARD toward upper-left and takes weight. NEAR LEFT leg is the REAR leg extending lower-right, toe grounded, heel only slightly raised. Far right leading shoe must appear ahead of near left trailing shoe along upper-left travel. Hip-knee-ankle connection shows right leading, not the image4 left leading. Very short grounded stride; do not expose big outsole, no jump.
